datasets.name: headline
queryLines: SELECT * FROM headline_latest ORDER BY source, contestant

datasets.name: claim
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT claim, data, n_tests FROM headline_latest WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM headline_latest ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1)

datasets.name: primary_headline
queryLines: SELECT within_20, coverage FROM headline_latest WHERE contestant = 'product_90d_median' AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM headline_latest ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1)

datasets.name: model_headline
queryLines: SELECT within_20, coverage FROM headline_latest WHERE contestant = 'model' AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM headline_latest ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1)

datasets.name: accuracy
queryLines:
SELECT source, contestant, kind, price_band, n, priced, within_20, coverage, median_ape,
       concat(source, ' / ', kind, ' / ', price_band) AS cell
FROM valuation_accuracy
WHERE NOT too_few AND within_20 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY source, kind, price_band, contestant

datasets.name: timeline
queryLines:
SELECT t.month, max(t.champion_value) AS champion_value,
       CASE WHEN count_if(t.action = 'rollback') > 0 THEN 'rollback'
            WHEN count_if(t.action = 'promote') > 0 THEN 'promote' ELSE 'hold' END AS action
FROM param_timeline t
JOIN (SELECT run_id, name, scope FROM param_moves ORDER BY month DESC, run_id DESC, name, scope LIMIT 1) chosen
  ON t.run_id = chosen.run_id AND t.name = chosen.name AND t.scope = chosen.scope
WHERE t.action IN ('promote', 'hold', 'rollback')
GROUP BY t.month ORDER BY t.month

datasets.name: moves
queryLines: SELECT run_id, data, name, scope, month, action, version, value, held_out_score, champion_score, diff, noise, reason FROM param_moves ORDER BY month DESC, run_id DESC, version DESC

datasets.name: history
queryLines: SELECT * FROM param_history ORDER BY _commit_version DESC, name, scope, version

datasets.name: citation
queryLines: SELECT sum(shown_with_citation) * 1.0 / nullif(sum(shown_numbers), 0) AS share FROM citation_coverage WHERE data <> 'synthetic'

datasets.name: recompute
queryLines: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN equal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / nullif(count(*), 0) AS share, sum(CASE WHEN equal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS equal_cases, count(*) AS cases FROM recompute_check

datasets.name: parity
queryLines: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN equal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / nullif(count(*), 0) AS share, sum(CASE WHEN equal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS equal_cases, count(*) AS cases FROM parity_check

datasets.name: hidden
queryLines: SELECT hide_reason, sum(count) AS count FROM hidden_numbers GROUP BY hide_reason ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: why
queryLines: SELECT id, number_id, basis_count, missing_basis, equal FROM recent_why ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

datasets.name: decisions
queryLines: SELECT policy_mode, sum(count) AS count FROM decisions_by_policy GROUP BY policy_mode ORDER BY count DESC

datasets.name: never
queryLines: SELECT id, kind, action, actor, site, policy_mode, data, allow, policy_version, why, created_at FROM never_automated ORDER BY created_at DESC, id

datasets.name: guard
queryLines: SELECT count(*) AS violations FROM guard_violations

datasets.name: policies
queryLines: SELECT catalog_name, schema_name, table_name, has_owner_tag, to_json(masked_columns) AS masked_columns, retention_class, rights_mode FROM policies_in_force ORDER BY table_name

datasets.name: governance
queryLines: SELECT table_catalog, table_schema, table_name, table_type, has_row_filter, masked_columns, direct_filter_count, direct_masked_columns, has_owner_tag, to_json(tags) AS tags FROM governance_coverage ORDER BY table_schema, table_name

datasets.name: lineage
queryLines: SELECT source_table_full_name, target_table_full_name, entity_type, last_seen FROM lineage_edges WHERE length(trim(target_table_full_name)) > 0 ORDER BY last_seen DESC

datasets.name: break_glass
queryLines: SELECT id, started_at, ended_at, is_open FROM break_glass_windows ORDER BY started_at DESC

datasets.name: audit
queryLines: SELECT event_date, sum(events) AS events FROM audit_activity GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY event_date

datasets.name: rights
queryLines: SELECT citations_checked, basis_rows_checked, violations FROM rights_audit_summary

datasets.name: pipeline
queryLines: SELECT source, data, bronze, dropped, kept, modelled, excluded_from_models, first_at, last_at FROM pipeline_funnel ORDER BY kept DESC

datasets.name: bench_coverage
queryLines: SELECT data, run_id, tool, question, asked, ok, ok_share FROM bench_coverage ORDER BY run_id, tool, question

datasets.name: bench_speed
queryLines: SELECT data, run_id, tool, question, n, first_p50_ms, first_p95_ms, full_p50_ms, full_p95_ms FROM bench_speed ORDER BY run_id, tool, question

datasets.name: bench_cited
queryLines: SELECT data, run_id, tool, numbers_shown, with_citation, share FROM bench_cited ORDER BY run_id, tool

lines:
| Promise | Databricks feature | What we add |
|---|---|---|
| Own rows only | Unity Catalog row filters and ABAC | Caller-to-person mapping; same rule in both stores |
| Handles masked | Column masks and governed tags | One policy covers newly tagged columns |
| Source rights retained | Catalog, table and column tags | Per-row rights and expectations; fits read comp_for_model |
| Shown numbers guarded | Metric views | Guard state and hide reason; thin numbers withheld |
| Numbers recomputable | Delta time travel, CDF and table lineage | Citation basis ids and hash; recomputation job |
| Claims backed by evidence | Unity Gateway policies (Beta) | claim_check; gateway second layer designed, not yet built |
| Some actions never automated | Grants; service-policy ASK for MCP calls | Versioned policy decisions; writes dry by default |
| Changes have a why | System audit | Decision and event reasons, actors and trace ids |
| Weights change on evidence | MLflow and Delta CDF | Held-out promotion beyond noise; rollback |
| Source data verified | Pipeline expectations and quality monitoring | Source hash and extractor version in each row |

frame.title: Policy tags
frame.description: Tags identify policy matches; they do not prove policy installation.

frame.title: Kept rows and rows excluded from modelling
frame.description: Excluded rows are part of kept rows. Bars are grouped, not added.
